verdict.rationale: Adyen Agentic is an agentic commerce platform, so post-purchase order status queries are a fair axis to judge it on. The evidence covers catalog feeds, the checkout session lifecycle (create, commit, cancel), payment tokenization and authorization. Nothing shows an agent querying order status or shipment tracking after purchase. Webhooks and the integration with existing order management systems are merchant-side, and the MCP server is described only generically, so none of these show agent-facing order tracking.
